spec.name: M5.AnchoredTupleCount.anchored_tuple_divisibility
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T d k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → Fin (T / d)), (P ∣ 1 + M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t ↔ AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t) = 1)
queries: finite set cardinality bijection natural division
spec.guidance: Use AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero for divisibility. Ring hom preserves addition and1, and the quotient is of characteristic2. No monicity/irreducibility needed. Return only tactic lines without leading by. Preserve the exact statement.

spec.name: M5.AnchoredTupleCount.anchored_R_count
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (T d k : ℕ), M5.ArithmeticTuple.R P hP T d k 1 = (M5.AnchoredTupleCount.count P T d k : ℤ)
queries: finite set cardinality bijection natural division
spec.guidance: Rewrite M5.ArithmeticTuple.R_exact. Unfold count and equate filters using anchored_tuple_divisibility, including k=0 and empty choice domains. Return only tactic lines without leading by. Preserve the exact statement.

spec.name: M5.AnchoredTupleCount.multiples_equivalence
spec.statement: ∀ T d : ℕ, 0 < T → d ∣ T → ∃ e : Fin (T / d) ≃ {r : Fin T // d ∣ r.val}, ∀ j : Fin (T / d), (e j).val.val = d * j.val
queries: finite set cardinality bijection natural division
spec.guidance: Build the equivalence j -> d*j, inverse r -> r/d. From positive T and d|T derive d>0 and d*(T/d)=T. Use Nat.mul_lt_mul and Nat.div_lt_div_right or division lemmas; all bound proofs explicit. This is a finite residue-domain equivalence, no enumeration of tuple pairs. Return only tactic lines without leading by. Preserve the exact statement.

spec.name: M5.AnchoredTupleCount.restricted_R_count
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (T d k : ℕ), 0 < T → d ∣ T → M5.ArithmeticTuple.R P hP T d k 1 = (M5.AnchoredTupleCount.restrictedCount P T d k : ℤ)
queries: finite set cardinality bijection natural division
spec.guidance: Use anchored_R_count and multiples_equivalence, lift the equivalence pointwise to functions Fin k. A tuple in the right filtered finset has every coordinate divisible by d; its inverse coordinate tuple is unique. The monomial exponents match by the equivalence property. Prove filtered finite cardinalities equal via a bijection (Finset.card_bij) or Fintype.card_congr. Preserve k=0, d=1, T=1, P=1 cases. Return only tactic lines without leading by. Preserve the exact statement.
